why: A changelog whose every date is a `<time datetime>` element, which converts to the machine date followed by the same day written for a person — `2026-08-04 Aug 4, 2026`. Reading that second date as prose rejected all 24 entries, so the most explicitly machine-readable date shape on the web was the one we could not read. Frozen because the page found the defect and is the only thing that would find it again.
